notes: This is the cover page of the Legislative Assembly of 1 December 2011: coat of arms, title block, who is in the chair, the two secretaries, and then a two-column attendance roll. NO SPEECH IS PRINTED ON IT — utterance_starts and events are both empty, and anything the parser attributes to a speaker here is a false positive (rule 8). I listed the two bold column heads of the roll, 'SENADORES PRESENTES:' and 'AUSENTES, CON AVISO:', as headings because they are printed as bold section heads; the title, presidency and secretaries blocks I treated as title-page furniture rather than headings. Note that the presidency block is descriptive matter set roman/bold on the cover, not an italic stenographer's note, so I did not record it as an event. Two typographic defects: (1) a stray full stop is printed alone in the left margin, level with the line 'y señor D. Enrique Hidalgo...', with nothing attached to it — it looks like a stray keystroke that survived into the printed page; (2) in the roll the entry reads 'MORANDINI. Norma E.' with a full stop where every other entry has a comma ('MORALES, Gerardo R.'). Both are as printed and I did not tidy them. The roll is set in a smaller size than the title block but is fully legible.
